youtube_title: Traffic Cop Took Your Bike Key for Old Challans? Rules You Didn't Know #8 #Shorts
youtube_description:
RULES YOU DIDN'T KNOW #8. A traffic cop stops you, pulls out your bike key and says: pay your old challans now. Is that allowed?
Answer: B, no. On 20 Jan 2026 the Telangana High Court (Justice N.V. Shravan Kumar) said police cannot snatch keys or force motorists to pay pending challans on the spot. Paying is voluntary; otherwise police must follow due process, such as court notices.
You still have to stop when signalled, show your documents and stay polite.
Source: Telangana High Court order, 20 Jan 2026 (reported by NewsMeter, Siasat, Telangana Today).

Signal pe roka aur cop ne bike ki chaabi nikaal li 🔑 'Purane challan abhi bharo!' Allowed hai? A ya B?
Sahi hai B — Telangana High Court (20 Jan 2026): chaabi chheen ke ya force karke pending challan on-the-spot bharwana allowed nahi. Bharna tumhari marzi; warna police ko due process (court notice) follow karna hoga.
Par haan: rukna hai, documents dikhane hain, aur politely baat karni hai.
